title: [Main] Unbalanced G/L Entries if you apply a Payment and a Posted Purchase Invoice having both different Posting Groups and using the "Applies-to Document No." on the line instead of using Apply Entries in the Spanish version.Initial commit
summary: Fixed unbalanced G/L entries when applying a payment to a purchase invoice with different posting groups using inline application in the Spanish version.
key_points: Application entries now correctly identify whether they belong to the applied document or the payment
Invoices post to their own posting-group payables account instead of the payment's account
Special handling in PostDtldVendLedgEntry and PostDtldVendLedgEntryUnapply ensures symmetry between apply and unapply operations
Issue only occurred with inline Applies-to Document No., not with Apply Entries
quote: Unbalanced G/L Entries if you apply a Payment and a Posted Purchase Invoice having both different Posting Groups
